title: Scott Addict RC 40 review
notes: Exact 2023-generation RC 40 review identifies the HMX frame and fork, reports Scott’s approximately 850 g frame and 340 g fork claims with size unspecified, publishes the correct seven-size RC geometry, and describes a stiff frameset with balanced compliance. The stiffness evidence is qualitative ride testing, not a numeric frame-deflection protocol.
